_note: Template of the city settings. Copy it to world.json (ignored by git, it holds your paths) or ask your AI to "set up my city", it walks you through docs/SETUP.md. Everything is optional and can be changed any time without restarting the server (except modules).
_notes: notes on a building: "folder" = notes only in the project folder, never in the Brain; "…/{slug}.md" = file template ({slug} = folder name in lowercase with dashes, {name} = folder name, {path} = floor path); "…/" = folder template. Without notes the agent writes notes nowhere, it only puts them in its answer.
